analysis_tile.description: Review each alert with before and after imagery, confirm it, set the loss driver, then save.
analysis_tile.info_md: Move between the alerts of the active set with the navigator; the set selector switches sets. The before and after maps show the closest cloud-free images: pick one of each. Draw or edit the deforested polygon, answer **Is this a true alert?**, choose the loss drivers, then **Save** writes the review into the set's alert store. **Download alert data** writes the alert's GeoPackage, its before/after images and a Word report built from the project's report template, chosen in the export card.

img_selection.no_images_msg: No images available for your area of interest and/or dates selected.

questionarie.confirmation_missing: Answer "Is this a true alert?" before saving.
questionarie.false_positive_drawn: A false positive cannot have a drawn deforestation polygon: delete the polygon or change the answer.

export_labels.download_no_recipe: No alert set is active, so there is nowhere in the project to save the alert files. Run Integrate & vectorize first.
export_labels.download_no_alert: No alert is selected, so there is nothing to download.
export_labels.download_no_images: No before and after images are selected for this alert, so its files cannot be built. Pick a before and an after image first.
export_labels.save_no_alert: No alert is selected, so there is nothing to save.
export_labels.save_other_set: These alerts belong to another alert set than the active one, so they were not saved into it.
export_labels.save_set_changed: The active alert set changed while saving, so this review was not saved.
export_labels.save_store_changed: This alert set was rebuilt while you were reviewing it, so the alerts on screen are out of date and this review was not saved. Review the rebuilt alerts instead.
